contract_term.value: Agreement in effect from date of official acceptance until December 31, 2025, with option to renew for up to one additional year, and option to renew for another one-year period thereafter, for a total period not to exceed three (3) years.
contract_term.quote: The agreement resulting from this RFP shall be in effect from the date of official acceptance by the County until December 31, 2025, subject to the following: (a) When mutually agreeable between the County and the successful proponent, this agreement may be renewed under the same terms and conditions for a period of up to one (1) additional year and said option to renew this agreement for an additional one (1) year period, shall be in effect for each year thereafter for a total period not to exceed three (3) years.

scope_of_deliverables.value: Rocky View County seeks an ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review service, to be provided by a selected proponent under a negotiated contract, with the County making no guarantee of the volume of work or exclusivity of the contract.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: This Request for Proposals (the "RFP") is an invitation by Rocky View County (the "County") to qualified prospective proponents to submit proposals for the County's ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, as further described in Section A of Appendix D of this RFP.

value: Complete and sign the Submission Form set out in Appendix B of this RFP by an authorized representative of the proponent.
Complete the Pricing Schedule as set out in Section F of Appendix D of this RFP and include it in the proposal submission.
Complete and submit the Mandatory Evaluation Table for the proposal.
mandatory_submission_requirements.quote: B.1 Submission Form Proponents are instructed to complete the Submission Form set out in Appendix B of this RFP and include it in their proposal submission. The Submission Form is to be signed by an authorized representative of the proponent. B.2 Pricing Proponents are instructed to complete the Pricing Schedule as set out in Section F of Appendix D of this RFP and include it in their proposal submission. Instructions on how to complete the Pricing Schedule are set out in Appendix C of this RFP. B.3 Other Mandatory Submission Requirements Proponents are instructed to complete and submit the Mandatory Evaluation Table below for their proposal. Proponents will be evaluated based on their responses to the criteria listed within the Mandatory Evaluation Table below. Any 'No' answers within the table will result in automatic disqualification unless the included justification satisfies the evaluation committee.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is one of five (5) criteria of the RFP that proponents will be evaluated on for which points will be awarded on a scale of 0 to 5 and will carry a weighting of 25% of the total RFP score. Pricing Evaluation will be on the Unit rate and the total cost basis. pricing formula: {(Submitted cost /Lowest cost) *Weight i.e. 25%}. The Proponent shall provide a TASK-FEE SCHEDULE (Unit price and Lump-sum price structure) showing the following, at a minimum: Proposed Professional Fees (PER PROJECT PHASE) to complete the work described herein, including any required Sub-Consultants. Estimated expenses/disbursements for each phase of the project. Service fees and rates shall be inclusive of all labour, materials, equipment, tools, consumables, indirect costs, insurance, Workers' Compensation, Vacation Pay Assessment, Canada Pension Plan, Employment Insurance, and all other payroll burdens, together with all applicable transportation and set-up costs to and from the job site(s), the Proponent's overhead and profit, and any other costs detailed or implied in these documents (except as otherwise specified). Rates must be provided in Canadian ($) funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes except for applicable sales taxes, which should be itemized separately.

references_required.quote: Proponents shall provide a MINIMUM OF THREE (3) (preferably PUBLIC SECTOR) client references for whom they have provided SIMILAR/ IDENTICAL SERVICES WITHIN THE LAST SEVEN (7) YEARS.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Vendor Shortlisting and Demonstration Preparation: The RFP Evaluation Committee will select the Vendors that will be shortlisted to provide a product demonstration and assist the County in clarifying any outstanding queries with shortlisted Vendors prior to the product demonstration process.

vendor_experience_required.value: no stated minimum years or project count for the firm; however, the Project Manager must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period. Project team members must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period. Preference will be given to Project Managers with professional project management certification(s) from recognized, accredited 3rd party organizations (i.e. the Project Management Institute (PMI)) or post-secondary academic institutions.
vendor_experience_required.quote: The Proponent's appointed Project Manager (and back-up Project Manager) shall have a minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period. Preference will be given to Project Managers with professional project management certification(s) from recognized, accredited 3rd party organizations (i.e. the Project Management Institute (PMI)) or post-secondary academic institutions. (b) Project team members must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period.
